ABOUT EKATERINA

Experience with a personal perspective.

With over 13 years of real estate experience and a background in finance, Ekaterina brings market knowledge, strong negotiation skills and a personalized approach to every transaction.

Having lived in York Region for over 20 years, she understands the local housing market and the importance of helping clients make informed decisions. Whether buying, selling or investing, she provides practical advice, clear communication and guidance throughout the process.

Every property is different, every deal has a story, and every client deserves individual attention.
